lessons.title: Tokenization & Word Embeddings
lessons.description: Convert raw human text into machine-readable continuous vector spaces using Byte-Pair Encoding and Word2Vec.

lessons.title: Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) & LSTMs
lessons.description: Model sequences using recurrent hidden states, diagnosing vanishing gradients in time, and gating information with LSTMs.

lessons.title: The Attention Mechanism
lessons.description: Understand why bottlenecking sequences into fixed vectors failed, and how Query-Key-Value attention revolutionizes context retrieval.

lessons.title: The Transformer Architecture
lessons.description: Deconstruct the seminal 'Attention Is All You Need' architecture: Multi-Head Attention, Positional Encodings, and Feed-Forward sublayers.
